title: [DEMO FIXTURE] Remote Code Execution in ExampleServer HTTP Core
description: DEMO DATA: A critical remote code execution vulnerability was identified in ExampleServer HTTP Core across versions 4.0 through 4.3. Attackers can leverage unauthenticated HTTP header manipulation to execute commands in the host context.

title: [DEMO FIXTURE] Information Disclosure in LegacyMail Gateway
description: DEMO DATA: An information disclosure flaw in LegacyMail Gateway versions below 2.5 allows authenticated users to read log buffers via debug API endpoints.
